title: Auxiliary Power Unit — Mount Heat Shield — Inspection of Shield Distortion and Link Fastener Torque
abstract: One-time inspection of the auxiliary power unit mount heat shield distortion and of the forward link fastener torque, to establish the extent of the condition across the fleet before a reinforcement is released.

sections.planning_reason: Compartment inspections found heat shield distortion around the forward mount link on twenty-three aircraft, two of them with measurable relaxation in the link fastener torque. The shield as delivered is unsupported over four hundred millimetres directly above the exhaust duct. Before a reinforcement can be sized, the extent of the condition across the fleet has to be known, and the only way to get it is to measure the distortion and the fastener torque on a representative population.
sections.description: This bulletin requires a distortion measurement at three positions on the shield and a torque check of the forward link fastener, with the results returned on a reply form. No parts are changed and the aircraft configuration is unaffected. The data is used to size the reinforcement and to establish whether an interim inspection interval is needed.
sections.accomplishment_summary: Open the auxiliary power unit compartment access and put the safety barriers in position. Measure the shield distortion at the three positions marked in the bulletin with the depth gauge and record each reading. Check the forward link fastener torque with the torque wrench set to the audit value and record the breakaway figure; do not re-torque the fastener. Close the compartment access and return the reply form.
sections.effectivity_note: Applies to MERIDIAN-42 and MERIDIAN-46 aircraft between MSN M00028 and M00310 that have not embodied MOD-168086. One accomplishment per aircraft is required.
sections.material_note: No kit. The torque wrench and the depth gauge are locally sourced. The reply form is returned to the address in the bulletin within thirty days of accomplishment.

type_data.compliance_time: At the next auxiliary power unit compartment opening, and in any case within 24 months after the date of this Service Bulletin.

title: Auxiliary Power Unit — Mount Heat Shield — Inspection of Shield Distortion and Link Fastener Torque

issue.reason: Cancelled and pointed at the reinforcement bulletin, whose first steps take the same measurements, so that the compartment is not opened twice for one set of data.

abstract: Cancelled one-time inspection of the auxiliary power unit mount heat shield distortion and forward link fastener torque, withdrawn when the reinforcement bulletin absorbed the inspection into its own accomplishment.

sections.planning_reason: Compartment inspections found heat shield distortion around the forward mount link on twenty-three aircraft, two with measurable relaxation in the link fastener torque. This bulletin was issued to establish the extent across the fleet before the reinforcement was released. Once the reinforcement bulletin was published with the same measurements built into its first three steps, keeping a separate inspection served no purpose and duplicated the compartment opening.
sections.description: The bulletin required a distortion measurement at three positions on the shield and a torque check of the forward link fastener, with the results returned on a reply form. No parts were changed. It is cancelled with no further action required; operators who accomplished it may credit the measurements against the first three steps of the reinforcement bulletin.
sections.accomplishment_summary: Cancelled. No accomplishment is required. Operators holding an open task against this bulletin should close it with reference to MRD-49-1017, which contains the same measurement steps and records the same data on its own reply form. Measurements already taken and returned under this bulletin remain valid and do not need to be repeated, provided the auxiliary power unit compartment has not been opened for other work since.
sections.effectivity_note: Applied to MERIDIAN-42 and MERIDIAN-46 aircraft between MSN M00028 and M00310 that had not embodied MOD-168086. The cancellation applies to the whole effectivity without exception.
sections.material_note: No kit was ever issued. The torque wrench and the depth gauge were locally sourced. Reply forms returned before cancellation have been retained in the fleet record.

revision_history.reason: Cancelled; superseded by MRD-49-1017 which contains the same measurements
